escenas.dice: A theater owner is found dead on the closing night of his own play.
Desmond Ashcombe, sixty-four. At the foot of his library ladder. Six books on the floor. His glasses, broken.
It looked like a fall. The medical examiner said it wasn't.
Police arrested the playwright. Two days later, they let him go. The case went cold.
Thirteen years later, builders renovating the empty theater find his missing notebook,
and two half-burned pages, hidden behind a loose panel.
His phone is still locked. Five people had a reason to want him dead.
